# LIONSIGN Studio

> Belgrade-based identity studio working across Doberman branding, digital design, landscape architecture and limited apparel.

Canonical site: https://www.lionsignstudio.com/
Primary language: English
Location: Belgrade, Serbia
Founded: 2019
Studio: LIONSIGN Studio
Founder: Kristina Radosavljević

## Canonical pages

- [LIONSIGN Studio](https://www.lionsignstudio.com/): studio overview, four focus areas and project inquiry route.
- [Doberman Branding](https://www.lionsignstudio.com/doberman-branding.html): branding, logotype, website and content direction for Doberman kennels.
- [Digital Design](https://www.lionsignstudio.com/digital-design.html): identity, web, campaign, packaging and content-direction work.
- [Landscape Design](https://www.lionsignstudio.com/landscape-design.html): landscape concepts, planting systems, color direction and selected Belgrade-area implementation.
- [Obsidian Line](https://www.lionsignstudio.com/obsidian-line.html): numbered limited-edition wearable artwork.
- [Studio Answers](https://www.lionsignstudio.com/answers.html): visible answers about the studio, its disciplines and working approach.

## Entity facts

- LIONSIGN Studio is based in Belgrade, Serbia.
- The studio was established in 2019.
- The founder is Kristina Radosavljević.
- The four public focus areas are Doberman Branding, Digital Design, Landscape Design and Obsidian Line.
- Landscape implementation is presented for selected Belgrade-area projects.
- Obsidian Line Edition 1 is presented as a 24-piece numbered release; current price and availability should be verified on the product page.
